# Catalog: host replacements

*Generated by `tools/inventory/port_inventory.py catalog` (also run by `port_inventory.py doc`) from the scan of the player's disc; do not edit by hand. The descriptions come from `tools/inventory/notes.txt` and the ports' `// orig:` comments.*

[Catalog index](README.md) · [Port inventory](../port-inventory.md)

Every place where the port replaces the original's hardware, library or kernel code with code of its own, the game's functions the host does on purpose without porting, the TODO_PORT stubs, and the host and enhancement-only code by module.

## The original's hardware, libraries and kernel, and what stands in for them

The port runs the game's own code; below it, what talked to the PS2's hardware, Sony's libraries, the IOP and the kernel is replaced by host code. None of these replacements makes a game decision: they take what the ported code hands them (a DMA chain, a sound command, a file read) and do the host's equivalent.

| Area | The original's side | Replaced by | Why | How it is checked |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| EE kernel: threads, vsync, interrupts | the kernel calls of the boot executable's core (threads, semaphores, the vsync wait, the DMA interrupt handlers 0x1187b0 / 0x1187d0); the game's thread structure | [`runtime/ee/ee_thread.cpp`](../../runtime/ee/ee_thread.cpp)<br>[`runtime/ee/ee_timer.cpp`](../../runtime/ee/ee_timer.cpp)<br>[`runtime/kernel/bootstrap.cpp`](../../runtime/kernel/bootstrap.cpp)<br>[`src/host/orig_main.cpp`](../../src/host/orig_main.cpp) | the game's main thread runs as a coroutine of the host's frame loop (ADR 0012); the host paces the frames, so the waits and handlers are stubs | the game's state per frame (`RAC1_RAMHASH`), the reference images; the ported callers are proved by their batches |
| DMA, the display packet, GS start-up | the DMA kicks and waits (0x2a08c8, 0x24d6d0, 0x200f18, 0x1221b0), the GS display / draw environments and memory set-up (0x1f80d0, 0x1f8540, 0x2005e8), the screen effects' GS list (0x1f9f78) | [`runtime/gs/gs_emu.cpp`](../../runtime/gs/gs_emu.cpp)<br>[`runtime/gs/gs_draw.cpp`](../../runtime/gs/gs_draw.cpp)<br>[`mrp_world_renderer.cpp`](../../src/game/render/mrp_world_renderer.cpp)<br>[`src/host/orig_main.cpp`](../../src/host/orig_main.cpp) | the host draws the frame itself: the GS replica walks the frame's chain for the 2D and the effects, the MRP draws the 3D; there is no DMA controller to start or wait for | the reference images (MRP and `RAC1_MRP=0`), `RAC1_RAMHASH`; the GS replica against the faithful path |
| VU1 microprograms: the 3D passes | the mobys' (0x250038's chain), the world's (tfrag, tie, shrub) and the sky's VU1 programs, the ties' PAL path (0x295bf8 .. 0x295d48) | [`mrp_scene.cpp`](../../src/game/render/mrp_scene.cpp)<br>[`mrp_moby_renderer.cpp`](../../src/game/render/mrp_moby_renderer.cpp)<br>[`mrp_world_scene.cpp`](../../src/game/render/mrp_world_scene.cpp)<br>[`mrp_world_renderer.cpp`](../../src/game/render/mrp_world_renderer.cpp)<br>[`mrp_tfrag_gpu.cpp`](../../src/game/render/mrp_tfrag_gpu.cpp)<br>[`runtime/vu/vu1.cpp`](../../runtime/vu/vu1.cpp) | the Modern Rendering Pipeline draws the passes on the GPU from the game's own decisions (the ported passes still run); the programs themselves are also translated, kept as the faithful reference (`RAC1_MRP=0`) | the translated programs by their batches (79, 93, 95, 104, 108); the MRP's assets against the programs, `RAC1_MRP_CHECK`, `RAC1_WORLD_MRP_CHECK`, `RAC1_RAMHASH` with and without the MRP (docs/rendering.md) |
| VU0 | the VU0 macro and micro mode the game uses (skinning, lighting), libvu0's routines | [`runtime/vu/vu0.cpp`](../../runtime/vu/vu0.cpp)<br>[`runtime/kernel/vu0.cpp`](../../runtime/kernel/vu0.cpp)<br>[`libvu0.cpp`](../../src/game/lib/libvu0.cpp)<br>[`vu0_macro.h`](../../src/game/ovl/vu0_macro.h) | a model of the VU0's registers and flags the ported code calls into; the micro programs translated | the oracle (batch 125 and the callers' batches) |
| SIF and the IOP | the SIF RPC client and the IOP's reboot and modules (0x123008, the boot module's 0x201520), the IOP start-up steps (0x217048, 0x232ce0) | [`runtime/sif/sif_rpc.cpp`](../../runtime/sif/sif_rpc.cpp)<br>[`runtime/iop/iop_ram.cpp`](../../runtime/iop/iop_ram.cpp)<br>[`runtime/iop/stash_iop.cpp`](../../runtime/iop/stash_iop.cpp) | the IOP's servers are host code: the SIF calls run synchronously against them | the ported callers' batches; playtests |
| Sound: 989snd | the 989snd driver on the IOP (989snd.irx) and its streams; the EE client (0x12da28 .., `snd_*`) is ported | [`snd989.cpp`](../../src/game/lib/snd989.cpp)<br>[`runtime/iop/snd989_iop.cpp`](../../runtime/iop/snd989_iop.cpp)<br>[`runtime/iop/snd989_stream.cpp`](../../runtime/iop/snd989_stream.cpp)<br>[`third_party/989snd/`](../../third_party/989snd/)<br>[`src/host/audio_out.cpp`](../../src/host/audio_out.cpp) | OpenGOAL's reimplementation of the driver mixes the voices; miniaudio plays them | the client's ports by their batches; the driver by listening (docs/audio.md) |
| The disc: libcdvd | libcdvd's reads, syncs and callbacks (sceCdRead 0x121450, sceCdSync 0x120c30 ..), the clock (0x121780) | [`libcdvd.cpp`](../../src/game/lib/libcdvd.cpp)<br>[`runtime/kernel/disc.cpp`](../../runtime/kernel/disc.cpp)<br>[`runtime/level/level_loader.cpp`](../../runtime/level/level_loader.cpp) | the player's ISO is read on the host, at once | the levels' loads (their data compared in the levels' batches); playtests |

| Movies: the IPU and the MPEG library | the movie player library each overlay links (0x2ee0e0 .. 0x2f0cd0: the IPU / MPEG decoder) | [`movie_player.cpp`](../../src/game/lib/movie_player.cpp)<br>[`runtime/ipu/movie_hw.cpp`](../../runtime/ipu/movie_hw.cpp) | FFmpeg's libavcodec decodes the MPEG-2 pictures, the SPU2 ADPCM sound is decoded on the host | watching the movies (docs/audio.md, Movies) |
| libgraph, libc, libgcc's soft float | the core's C library, soft-float routines and libgraph | [`libc.cpp`](../../src/game/lib/libc.cpp)<br>[`libgcc_fp.cpp`](../../src/game/lib/libgcc_fp.cpp)<br>[`libgraph.cpp`](../../src/game/lib/libgraph.cpp) | C++ equivalents with the original's results (the soft float's rounding included); libgraph's GS calls go to the GS replica | the oracle (batch 139 among others), the callers' batches |
| The debug font and the debug strings | the boot module's debug font (0x1e9168, 0x1e9338), the debug string draw (0x1f3770) | [`front_end.cpp`](../../src/game/boot/front_end.cpp)<br>[`overlay_entry.cpp`](../../src/game/ovl/overlay_entry.cpp) | development output the retail game does not show | (not needed) |

`RAC1_RAMHASH=<file>` hashes every 4 KB page of EE memory after every game frame: a host-side change is checked to leave the game's state as it was by comparing it with the unchanged build (docs/oracle.md).

## Host and enhancement code by module

The markers of the sources (see [Architecture](../architecture.md#srcgame-the-port)): `// orig: (host)` marks host code standing in for something of the original's (a dispatcher, a renderer's step, a hook the port needs), `// orig: (helper)` a helper split out of a ported function, `// orig: (none) — enhancement` PC-only code (the options pages and the enhancements, see [Enhancements](../enhancements.md)), `// orig: (none)` other code of our own.
